summary.text: Heather Goulding is a Democratic Nevada Assembly member from District 27 who took office in November 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A project manager and nonprofit leader, she described education, reproductive rights and affordable housing as priorities in a 2024 Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Goulding was born in Milton, Florida, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin, Madison, in 1987 and a graduate degree from the University of Nevada, Reno, in 1997.
Her career experience includes working as a project manager and nonprofit leader.
Her 2024 survey response credits her with leading the passage of Senate Bill 295 (2019), which established the Battle Born Youth ChalleNGe Academy.
Goulding assumed office on November 6, 2024, succeeding Angie Taylor.
For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Government Affairs, Health and Human Services, and Revenue committees.
